embeds.title: 🧪 poison decay — worked examples (Draughtsman Moe)
embeds.description:
Following up on the decay note above — here's exactly what a solo Draughtsman Moe (or Blight-Witch) does to one target, no resist in the mix.

**★1** — 1 stack, floor 1
```
tick    1  2  3  4  5 ...
damage  1  1  1  1  1   (flat forever)
```
**★2** — 3 stacks, floor 2
```
tick    1  2  3  4  5 ...
damage  3  2  2  2  2   (flat from tick 2)
```
**★3** — 5 stacks, floor 3
```
tick    1  2  3  4  5 ...
damage  5  3  3  3  3   (flat from tick 2)
```
Running totals over the first 10 ticks: **10 / 21 / 32**. Poison ignores armor outright — these numbers land no matter what the target's wearing. `poisonAllEnemies` hits every enemy in the wave with this same sequence independently, and it all resets clean next wave.
